about_the_game:
Roata Mai is a high-octane, neon-soaked twist on the classic brick breaker formula — but instead of a ball, you're bouncing a deadly buzzsaw that slices through everything in its path!

Your mission is to control the deflector platform and unleash chaos by ricocheting your saw into waves of enemies and breakable structures.
Enemies won’t go down easily: some move erratically, others are armored from multiple sides, and a few even construct barriers mid-fight to block your attacks.

Master the art of bouncing destruction, collect powerful upgrades, and survive the onslaught. Launch extra saws, expand your platform, or activate temporary boosts — but beware: not all power-ups are your friends. Some will shrink your paddle, steal your weapon, or cost you a precious life.

Fast-paced, explosive, and endlessly satisfying — every level in Ammo Bounce is a neon battlefield of steel and reflexes.

Key Features:

  • 🌀 Classic brick breaker action with a brutal twist

  • ⚔️ Deadly buzzsaw instead of a ball — shred your way through enemies

  • 🔧 Power-ups and debuffs that dramatically shift gameplay

  • 🧠 Smart and varied enemy mechanics: movement, armor, barriers

  • 🎶 Pulse-pounding soundtrack and vibrant neon visuals

  • 🎯 Precision, reflexes, and chaos combined

Can you control the storm of steel and become the true Master of the Saw?
